title: Corner Notifications
description: The floating box in the bottom-left corner that tells a player when the game made a single-choice decision for them.

shots.heading: One automatic choice
shots.caption: When a decision has only one legal option the game takes it and says so: the decision type in bold, and what was selected in green.

shots.heading: Several in a row
shots.caption: Notifications stack upwards from the corner and each disappears on its own after about 3.5 seconds. A long value now wraps instead of being cut off.

shots.heading: Where it sits
shots.caption: The box is fixed to the bottom-left of the window, clear of the map and the player sheet.

notes.title: Not connected yet
notes.text: Nothing in the game creates these notifications today. The component and its hook exist, but the app never calls them, so the screenshots come from a dev-only page (/dev/toasts).

notes.title: Other players' actions
notes.text: There is no notification kind for what another player did. Only the auto-selected kind exists.

notes.title: Fix made while capturing
notes.text: Long values used to be truncated with an ellipsis ("T…"), hiding the selection. The text now wraps.
